'''Bloodrites''' are intense rituals conducted by the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. To earn full adult status within their tribe, [[Youngling/Legends|young]] Tusken hunters must torture a [[Species/Legends|creature]] to [[Death/Legends|death]] over a period of [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]]. To gain highest status amongst the clan, the [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] creature must belong to a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species. The importance of this ritual drives rival Tusken clans to [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] one another during bloodrite season, a time when [[Human/Legends|human]] settlers and [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] are particularly vulnerable as prized torture victims.<ref name="SWI62">{{InsiderCite|62|Inside Attack of the Clones|Inside ''Attack of the Clones''}}</ref> [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] fell victim to a Tusken clan's bloodrite ritual in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> while picking [[Vaporator mushroom/Legends|vaporator mushrooms]]<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> at the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars moisture farm]].
